OWNER_EMAIL.description: Email address of the installation owner. After deployment, open the single-use sign-in link at the end of the build log to create your passkey.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Account ID for this installation, from the Cloudflare dashboard. Use the same account as the build token.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Optional and normally left unset. Only for enabling AI (AI Gateway Edit) or the advanced in-app domain connection.

AGENT_JWT_SECRET.description: Leave unset: the installer generates it on the first deployment and keeps it. Signs agent credentials only.

BOXOX_SIGNING_SECRET.description: Leave unset: the installer generates it on the first deployment and keeps it. Root for every other key.
